stories.title: Acampadas en España por la vivienda, en directo | El Gobierno insiste a Junts: “Hemos incorporado el 90% de sus propuestas. Voten a favor o absténganse”

en.title: Housing encampments in Spain, live | Government insists to Junts: "We have incorporated 90% of your proposals. Vote in favor or abstain"
en.summary: The government minister offers Junts the opportunity to process decrees as legislative projects once approved to include amendments. This comes as the government seeks support for housing-related legislation.

stories.title: Un diputado de Sumar increpa a la portavoz del PP en el Congreso por votar "no" a los decretos: "¡Lo vais a pagar!"

en.title: A Sumar deputy challenges the PP spokesperson in Congress for voting "no" to decrees: "You will pay for it!"
en.summary: A Compromís-Sumar spokesperson confronted the PP's parliamentary representative over votes against decrees. The PP spokesperson accused him of verbal violence, while he countered that voting against housing protections constitutes violence.

stories.title: Un diputado de Compromís increpa a Ester Muñoz a las puertas del Congreso: «¿Podrán dormir tranquilos?»

en.title: A Compromís deputy confronts Ester Muñoz at Congress doors: "Will you be able to sleep peacefully?"
en.summary: Tension escalated at Congress when a Compromís deputy verbally confronted the PP spokesperson outside the chamber. The PP representative reported intimidation attempts and described the incident as violent behavior.

stories.title: El Gobierno arremete contra el PP y ruega a Junts que no torpedee los decretos de vivienda

en.title: Government attacks PP and pleads with Junts not to obstruct housing decrees
en.summary: A government spokesperson challenged parliamentary groups to choose between supporting housing assistance or opposing it. The government framed the vote as deciding between helping people or supporting evictions.

stories.title: Sumar convoca de urgencia una reunión de partidos para "acelerar" con el candidato en un clima de adelanto electoral

en.title: Sumar urgently convenes party meeting to "accelerate" with candidate amid early election climate
en.summary: Sumar is calling an urgent meeting of political parties to advance its candidate strategy during a period of potential early elections. A party leader is urging the prime minister to remain calm, noting a lack of leftist allies for coalition building.

stories.title: Junts presenta un texto alternativo para salvar ‘in extremis’ un acuerdo sobre vivienda

en.title: Junts presents alternative text to salvage housing agreement at last minute
en.summary: The Catalan independence party has submitted a document to the government proposing a new starting point for negotiating housing policy legislation.

stories.title: Dirigentes del PSOE y ministros del Gobierno creen que Sánchez debe convocar elecciones si se tumban los decretos

en.title: PSOE leaders and government ministers believe Sánchez should call elections if decrees are rejected
en.summary: Socialist party officials and government ministers expect early elections are "99% likely" if a key legislative decree fails validation. November 29 would be the earliest possible election date if parliament is dissolved.

stories.title: Tres detenidos por el tiroteo con dos guardias civiles heridos en Tarrasa

en.title: Three arrested for shooting with two Civil Guard officers wounded in Tarrasa
en.summary: Three individuals have been detained following a shooting incident in Tarrasa that left two Civil Guard officers injured. Catalan police continue investigating to apprehend additional suspects involved in the attack.

stories.title: Junts presenta hoy una propuesta propia de decreto para negociar si el Gobierno retira la suya

en.title: Junts presents its own decree proposal today to negotiate if the Government withdraws its own
en.summary: Junts demanded that the PSOE withdraw two housing-related royal decrees scheduled for congressional vote today and negotiate a new text. The independentist party announced it will present its own prepared proposal as a starting point for negotiations.

stories.title: Tres detenidos por el tiroteo de Terrassa en el que dos agentes de la Guardia Civil resultaron heridos

en.title: Three arrested for the Terrassa shooting in which two Civil Guard officers were wounded
en.summary: Three people were arrested following a shooting in Terrassa where two Civil Guard officers were injured while pursuing a group of thieves. One officer was reported in serious condition.

stories.title: Heridos en un tiroteo en Terrassa dos guardias civiles que seguían a un grupo de 'teloneros'

en.title: Two Civil Guard officers wounded in Terrassa shooting while following a group of thieves
en.summary: Two Civil Guard officers were shot in Terrassa while pursuing thieves. One officer, struck by four bullets, was reported to be in serious but stable condition.

stories.title: Junts presentará hoy una propuesta propia en vivienda para empezar a negociar

en.title: Junts will present its own housing proposal today to begin negotiations
en.summary: Junts will present its own proposal today to start negotiations but demands the Government withdraw its texts, which the Government refuses, calling on the PP, Vox and JxCat to clarify their positions.

stories.title: La inflación de la zona euro escala al 3,8% en septiembre y alcanza máximos de tres años

en.title: Eurozone inflation climbs to 3.8% in September, reaching three-year highs
en.summary: Eurozone inflation rose to 3.8% in September, up from the previous month, driven by increases in fuel and food prices. The surge marks the highest inflation rate seen in three years.

stories.title: El Ibex se juega los 19.000 puntos con el empleo de EEUU

en.title: Ibex tests 19,000 points ahead of US employment data
en.summary: The Spanish stock index approaches a key level as markets await eurozone inflation and US employment figures ahead of the Federal Reserve's monthly meeting. Easing pressure from bond yields and oil prices provided some support.

stories.title: Cuatro posibles aspectos positivos del aumento de los rendimientos de los bonos

en.title: Four potential positive aspects of rising bond yields
en.summary: While higher financing costs have caused concern, rising bond yields also present certain benefits to investors and markets.

stories.title: El bitcoin inicia 'uptober' lanzado a por nuevos máximos

en.title: Bitcoin launches into 'uptober' targeting new highs
en.summary: Bitcoin entered October with strong gains, historically one of the year's most favorable months for the cryptocurrency. Its performance contrasts with turbulence in other markets and brings it close to ending 2026 with positive annual returns.

stories.title: Navantia redobla su apuesta por el contrato de corbetas croata y forja nuevas alianzas locales

en.title: Navantia doubles down on Croatian corvette contract and forges new local alliances
en.summary: Spanish shipbuilder Navantia is pursuing a Croatian corvette contract with its Avante 2200/Alfa 3000 vessel, a lightweight warship designed for various missions. The company previously sold five units of this model to Saudi Arabia in 2018 for approximately 1.8 billion euros.
